messages:
Alex (CEO): Opening this thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands re: mission and positioning. Post quick Qs here. :wave:
Sam (Product): Can we boil the mission down to a single sentence for PRDs?
Alex (CEO): Draft: 'Make inference predictable, efficient, and portable for engineering teams.' Use that as the short form.
Ravi (Sales): For sales one-pager: headline = 'Predictable inference economics' or 'Performance everywhere'? Which to push?
Alex (CEO): Headline: 'Predictable inference economics.' Subhead: 'Same developer experience across hosted, dedicated, and private.'
Priya (CTO): Technical visibility question: top-level marketing will say "engineered runtime". Do we expose kernel/quant details in docs?
Jordan (Eng): Keep marketing high-level. Publish a technical appendix with kernels, seq-length benchmarks, and config snippets for platform teams.
Sam (Product): I'll draft the one-pager + internal FAQ. Need 2 anonymized mini-case studies showing cost/latency improvements.
Ravi (Sales): I'll collect customer anecdotes for those case studies. Also need a Dedicated vs Private plain-language explainer for SAs.
Marta (People Ops): Once published, I'll add links to the onboarding checklist and a short slide deck for new hires.
Alex (CEO): Action items: Product (Sam) one-pager + FAQ; Eng (Jordan/Priya) benchmark appendix; Sales (Ravi) collect anecdotes. Target: next Friday. I'll follow up Monday.
Jordan (Eng): We'll include copy-paste config examples to speed PoCs. Example:
```
model: open-7b
runtime: redwood-runtime-v2
quant: q4_0
batch_policy: latency-optimized
```
Alex (CEO): Thanks all 97 that'll do for now. Post any small follow-ups here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
